Prehensile_Chameleon_Tail.description: A dense, tightly coiling muscular tail designed to anchor around branches securely. It functions entirely as an emergency climbing strut and fifth limb, ensuring the entity is nearly impossible to dislodge.

Heavy_Counterweight_Tail.description: A tremendously thick, rigid tail extending backward to perfectly balance the mass of a massive forward-leaning torso and head. It allows a bipedal saurian to turn on a dime during high-speed chases.

Osteoderm_Club_Tail.description: A thick, muscular tail terminating in a fused mass of solid bone osteoderms causing it to operate exactly like a medieval mace. A single defensive swing can easily shatter the leg bones of apex predators.
